---
title: "Contact"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<section class="contact-shell page-frame">

  <div class="contact-identity" data-reveal>
    <div class="contact-portrait photo-slot" role="img" aria-label="Portrait image placeholder"></div>

    <div class="contact-lines">
      <span class="contact-name-line"></span>
      <span class="w55"></span>
      <span class="w70"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="contact-panel" data-reveal>
    <div class="page-kicker">Contact</div>
    <div class="skeleton-heading wide"></div>

    <form class="contact-form-template" onsubmit="return false;">
      <label>
        <span>Name</span>
        <input type="text" autocomplete="name">
      </label>

      <label>
        <span>Email</span>
        <input type="email" autocomplete="email">
      </label>

      <label class="full">
        <span>Message</span>
        <textarea rows="7"></textarea>
      </label>

      <button type="submit" aria-label="Submit form"><span>↗</span></button>
    </form>
  </div>

</section>
```
